skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 70% ATK (+5) damage to a single target with a 2-hit combo, and grants self [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 25% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Each stack of [Charge] deals extra Charge damage equal to 24% ATK to the target hit. Deals 160% ATK damage to each back-row enemy with a 5-hit combo.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Each stack of [Charge] deals extra Charge damage equal to 30% ATK to the target hit. Deals 240% ATK damage to each back-row enemy with a 5-hit combo, with a 100% chance to inflict [Weaken] on critically-hit targets (reduces ATK by 30% for 2 turns).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Each time self gains a [Tenacity] state, gains 1 stack of [Charge], up to 2 stacks. Permanently increases the ATK of allies in a [Charge] state by 25%. Self permanently gains 40% Non-CRIT DMG immunity (the reduction includes all damage types; this effect and [Agility] only one takes effect).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Each time self gains a [Tenacity] state, gains 1 stack of [Charge], up to 2 stacks. Permanently increases the ATK of allies in a [Charge] state by 35%. Self permanently gains 45% Non-CRIT DMG immunity (the reduction includes all damage types; this effect and [Agility] only one takes effect).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Each time self gains a [Tenacity] state, gains 1 stack of [Charge], up to 2 stacks. Permanently increases the ATK of allies in a [Charge] state by 45%. Self permanently gains 55% Non-CRIT DMG immunity (the reduction includes all damage types; this effect and [Agility] only one takes effect).

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
